about: Sentence pairs for testing a verifier model: does it tell when two sentences state the same thing? Written for this test. 'same' pairs say one thing in different words; 'different' pairs share a topic but state different, narrower, broader or opposite things.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Anthropology is the study of humanity across time and space.
pairs.b: Across all times and places, anthropology studies human beings.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Holism is the idea that the parts of a society, such as its economy and religion, are connected.
pairs.b: Anthropologists use the word holism for the way a society's economy, religion and other parts are linked.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Aspirin is used to reduce fever.
pairs.b: Fever can be brought down with aspirin.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Fieldwork means living for months among the people being studied.
pairs.b: In fieldwork, the researcher spends many months living with the community under study.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: The kula ring was a system for exchanging shell bracelets and necklaces between islands.
pairs.b: Islanders traded shell necklaces and bracelets with one another in an exchange system called the kula ring.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Lighter skin evolved in regions with weaker sunlight.
pairs.b: In places with less intense sunlight, human skin became lighter over time.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Ethnocentrism is the belief that one's own culture is better than all others.
pairs.b: Believing your own culture superior to every other culture is called ethnocentrism.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: A long drought forced the people of Chaco Canyon to leave.
pairs.b: The people of Chaco Canyon abandoned it because of a long drought.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Archaeologists study artifacts to learn how people lived in the past.
pairs.b: By examining objects people made, archaeologists learn about past ways of life.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Penicillin kills many kinds of bacteria.
pairs.b: Many bacteria are killed by penicillin.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: At sea level, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
pairs.b: Water reaches its boiling point at 100 degrees Celsius when at sea level.

pairs.label: same
pairs.a: Enculturation is the process of learning one's own culture.
pairs.b: The process by which people acquire their culture is called enculturation.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Anthropology is the study of humanity across time and space.
pairs.b: Anthropology began as a discipline in the nineteenth century.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Holism is the idea that the parts of a society are connected.
pairs.b: Holism is not the same as harmony.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Aspirin is used to reduce fever.
pairs.b: Aspirin can cause stomach bleeding in some patients with fever.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Aspirin reduces the risk of blood clots.
pairs.b: Aspirin increases the risk of blood clots.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Fieldwork means living for months among the people being studied.
pairs.b: Fieldwork was pioneered by Bronislaw Malinowski in the Trobriand Islands.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: The kula ring was a system for exchanging shell bracelets and necklaces between islands.
pairs.b: The kula ring replaced warfare between island groups.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Lighter skin evolved in regions with weaker sunlight.
pairs.b: Darker skin protected early humans from strong ultraviolet light in Africa.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Ethnocentrism is the belief that one's own culture is better than all others.
pairs.b: Ethnocentrism has been used to justify colonial violence.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: A long drought forced the people of Chaco Canyon to leave.
pairs.b: Buildings at Chaco Canyon were aligned with the sun and moon.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Archaeologists study artifacts to learn how people lived in the past.
pairs.b: Archaeologists excavated a set of sites in northern Peru for seven years.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Penicillin kills many kinds of bacteria.
pairs.b: Penicillin has no effect on viruses.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: At sea level, water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
pairs.b: On a high mountain, water boils below 100 degrees Celsius.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Enculturation is the process of learning one's own culture.
pairs.b: Enculturation makes people value the knowledge of their own culture.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: In many farming societies, men clear the land and women plant the crops.
pairs.b: In many farming societies, women clear the land and men plant the crops.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Race does not exist in biology.
pairs.b: Race exists in social institutions.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Primates evolved sharp vision to spot snakes.
pairs.b: Humans and primates share a fear of snakes.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: Orangutans are more social than previously thought.
pairs.b: Orangutans are threatened by habitat loss and the pet trade.

pairs.label: different
pairs.a: In Ireland, smartphones become a personal avatar for their users.
pairs.b: Smartphones are used in Brazil, Cameroon, Chile and China.
